lines.en: label day50:
scene dayfifty1
Another[school] day gets off to a relatively mild-mannered start.
I don’t feel like doing anything today, so I told the girls they can just do whatever it is they want.
"Of course, Makoto was opposed to the idea and has, per usual, gone back to studying like the success-driven
prefect she is."
Ami and Maya are chatting, Chika is on her phone, Futaba is reading...
Ayane is...staring directly at me...
Yup. Pretty much everything looks normal today.
Well, almost everything...
scene dayfifty2
: Huh...Rin’s not here again...
Normally, I wouldn’t think anything of it if one of the girls were to miss a class or two.
"But Rin’s been starting to miss a lot lately. And I know she told me not to
worry but I can’t help wondering if she’s really doing okay."
Maybe Futaba knows something?
: Hey, Futaba...
scene dayfifty3
: Sensei? Is something wrong?
: You don’t normally visit me at my desk...
: I was actually just wondering if you knew anything about why Rin’s been absent so much lately.
scene dayfifty4
: Are you worried about her?
: Of course I am. Just like I’d be worried about you if you started going missing all the time.
scene dayfifty5
: Well, uhh...I mean, I kind of know...I just don’t know if she’d be happy with me telling you or not.
scene dayfifty6
f "She’s, umm...Well, she’s not really in the best state of mind right now. That’s
probably the easiest way to put it."
"Huh...She did say all that stuff about ‘thinking things she wasn’t
supposed to,’ or however it was she put it."
I’m assuming that’s what Futaba is talking about here.
: Is there like...something wrong with her?
scene dayfifty7
: Sensei! That’s a horrible way to word that question! Of course nothing’s wrong with her...
: Oh, I didn’t mean anything bad by that. You’re right. It was poor phrasing.
: What I’m trying to ask is if she needs our help or medical help or anything like that.
: I don’t really know what to do in situations like these.
scene dayfifty5
: Well...I guess that can’t really be helped.
: I never really knew what to do until recently either. It’s not exactly something that[school] prepares you for.
: How long have you two known each other again?
scene dayfifty8
: Oh jeez, I can’t even remember. I think since elementary[school]?
: What I do remember is that she was the one to approach me first.
scene dayfifty9
: I wasn’t really the best at making friends, and I guess she just realized that before everyone else.
That definitely sounds like the Rin I know...Weirdly outgoing and always thinking about other people.
"After all, this is the same person who’s still actively trying to set me up with her roommate just because
she thinks it will make both of us happy."
It’s weird thinking that she’s hiding some sort of other life behind all of that.
scene dayfifty8
: She wasn’t always like this, though...
scene dayfifty9
: Well, I guess that’s not entirely accurate.
: I guess it’s more of an ‘it’s never been that serious’ kind of thing...
scene dayfifty8
: Normally, she gets better after a day or two. Sometimes even a few hours.
scene dayfifty10
: But...
Futaba’s smile is suddenly wiped off of her face as she comes to terms with how unusual her current situation is.
: I feel like she’s barely even been getting out of bed lately...
: I’m kind of worried about leaving her alone, actually...
: You don’t think she’d do anything...stupid, do you?
scene dayfifty11
: Not at all. She’d never do anything like that.
f "She might be going through some stuff right now, but I know that deep down, she
loves pretty much everyone and everything."
: I thought the same thing.
s "I mean, obviously you know her much better than I do, but I’m pretty
sure she’ll pull through whatever it is that’s going on."
scene dayfifty8
if futaba_love > 9:
: I knew you’d agree with me there. That’s just the kind of person you are, Sensei...
: You might try to hide it, but I can tell how much you care about all of us...
: Plus, Rin’s been saying a lot of nice things about you lately.
scene dayfifty12
: I’m actually...kind of jealous she’s been seeing you so much...hahaha...
: Really? What has she been saying?
else:
: I had a feeling you’d agree with me.
: Rin’s been saying nothing but nice things about you lately.
: Really? Like what?
scene dayfifty8
: Just things about how you’re really cool for your age and that you’re fun to be around...stuff like that.
Huh...I had no idea Rin would actually be talking about me to other people.
I mean, it is her roommate, though, so I'm sure it just randomly came up in conversation once or twice.
I shouldn’t get too excited about that.
: Well that’s really nice of her. Whenever I make friends my age, I’ll be sure to tell them about her as well.
: Heheh~ Are you sure that’s the best idea?
: Actually, no. I’m sure that would be a horrible idea.
: But either way, do you think there’s anything I can do for her?
scene dayfifty4
: For Rin?
: I mean...I don’t think she wants to see anyone right now but...
scene dayfifty8
: Maybe you could try writing her a letter?
: A letter?
f "Yeah. You know how powerful words can be. I’m sure that a nice letter or a present
or something would make her feel a little better."
: I know it would for me, at least.
: Huh...
: Yeah, I think I can do that. Hold on one sec.
scene black
I walk back to my desk and start scribbling down whatever words come to mind.
I finish within a matter of minutes. It’s actually surprisingly easy writing something like this for her.
Here’s hoping she likes it...
scene dayfifty8
: Done already?
: Yup. You’ve gotta promise not to read it, though, okay?
: And let me know what she says once she sees it.
: I’m sure she’ll be able to let you know herself soon enough, Sensei.
: Even better. Thanks, Futaba.
: Of course. Thank you for caring enough to ask, Sensei...
: I’m sure that will mean a lot to her.
scene black
The rest of the class carries on as normal...
$ day50 = True
jump afterschoolevent
